mapper.sql: SELECT a.att03_overtime_req_id AS overtime_req_id , a.att03_work_date::date AS work_date , a.att03_work_type_cd AS work_type_code , f_cdnm('WorkTypeCode', a.att03_work_type_cd, a.att03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS work_type_name , a.att03_overtime_min AS overtime_min , CASE WHEN a.att03_work_type_cd = '10' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM att05_pm_work pm LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = att03_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' AND pm.att05_person_id = a.att03_person_id AND pm.att05_work_date = a.att03_work_date ) THEN aop.att01_pm_work_end_time::time ELSE aop.att01_work_end_time::time END, 'HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR((CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM att05_pm_work pm LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = att03_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' AND pm.att05_person_id = a.att03_person_id AND pm.att05_work_date = a.att03_work_date ) THEN aop.att01_pm_work_end_time::time ELSE aop.att01_work_end_time::time END + (a.att03_overtime_min || ' minutes')::interval), 'HH24:MI') WHEN a.att03_work_type_cd = '20' THEN TO_CHAR(aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time, 'HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR((aptc.pay34_nt_start_time::time + (a.att03_overtime_min || ' minutes')::interval), 'HH24:MI') END AS over_time_str , a.att03_reason AS reason , a.att03_work_reward_type_cd AS work_reward_type_code , f_cdnm('WorkRewardTypeCode', a.att03_work_reward_type_cd, a.att03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS work_reward_type_name , a.att03_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name FROM att03_overtime_req a INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = a.att03_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN att01_work_policy aop ON aop.att01_company_id = a.att03_company_id AND aop.att01_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(att01_start_date) FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = a.att03_company_id AND att01_start_date <= a.att03_work_date ) LEFT OUTER JOIN pay34_work_time_config aptc ON aptc.pay34_start_date = ( SELECT pay34_start_date FROM pay34_work_time_config t WHERE t.pay34_company_id IN (a.att03_company_id, 0) AND t.pay34_start_date <= a.att03_work_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pay34_company_id = a.att03_company_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , t.pay34_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr ON apr.apr01_appr_id = a.att03_appr_id
mapper.select: WITH weekly_sum AS ( SELECT att03_person_id , date_trunc('week', att03_work_date) AS week_start , FLOOR(SUM(att03_overtime_min) / 60.0) AS week_total_hour FROM att03_overtime_req LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = att03_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' GROUP BY att03_person_id, date_trunc('week', att03_work_date) ), monthly_sum AS ( SELECT att03_person_id , date_trunc('month', att03_work_date) AS month_start , FLOOR(SUM(att03_overtime_min) / 60.0) AS month_total_hour FROM att03_overtime_req LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = att03_appr_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' GROUP BY att03_person_id, date_trunc('month', att03_work_date) ) SELECT CASE WHEN ws.att03_person_id IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN ws.week_total_hour = aptc.pay34_week_max_add_hours THEN '<'||'b style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'|| (ws.week_total_hour || ' / ' || aptc.pay34_week_max_add_hours) ||'<'||'/b'||'>' ELSE '<'||'b style=color:#4B81B9;'||'>'|| (ws.week_total_hour || ' / ' || aptc.pay34_week_max_add_hours) ||'<'||'/b'||'>' END AS week_report , CASE WHEN pay01_month_ot_hours IS NULL OR ms.month_total_hour IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN ms.month_total_hour = annal.pay01_month_ot_hours THEN '<'||'b style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'|| (ms.month_total_hour || ' / ' || annal.pay01_month_ot_hours) ||'<'||'/b'||'>' ELSE '<'||'b style=color:#4B81B9;'||'>'|| (ms.month_total_hour || ' / ' || annal.pay01_month_ot_hours) ||'<'||'/b'||'>' END AS month_report FROM emp01_person emp LEFT OUTER JOIN att03_overtime_req a ON emp.emp01_person_id = a.att03_person_id AND a.att03_work_date = #{baseDate}::date LEFT OUTER JOIN pay34_work_time_config aptc ON aptc.pay34_start_date = ( SELECT pay34_start_date FROM pay34_work_time_config t WHERE t.pay34_company_id IN (emp.emp01_company_id, 0) AND t.pay34_start_date <= #{baseDate}::date ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pay34_company_id = emp.emp01_company_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , t.pay34_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT OUTER JOIN pay01_annual annal ON annal.pay01_start_date = ( SELECT pay01_start_date FROM pay01_annual t WHERE t.pay01_person_id = emp.emp01_company_id AND t.pay01_start_date <= #{baseDate}::date ORDER BY t.pay01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND annal.pay01_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN weekly_sum ws ON ws.att03_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id AND ws.att03_person_id = #{personId} AND ws.week_start = date_trunc('week', #{baseDate}::date) LEFT OUTER JOIN monthly_sum ms ON ms.att03_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id AND ms.att03_person_id = #{personId} AND ms.month_start = date_trunc('month', #{baseDate}::date) WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} LIMIT 1

SELECT att01_work_end_time AS work_end_time , att01_pm_work_end_time AS pm_work_end_time FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = #{companyId} AND att01_use_yn = 'true'
AND att01_start_date <= #{baseDate}::date
ORDER BY att01_start_date

SELECT pay34_nt_start_time AS nt_start_time , pay34_nt_end_time AS nt_end_time , pay34_week_max_add_hours AS week_max_add_hours FROM pay34_work_time_config WHERE pay34_company_id IN (#{companyId}, 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pay34_company_id = #{companyId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , pay34_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att03_overtime_req ( att03_overtime_req_id, att03_company_id, att03_person_id, att03_work_date, att03_overtime_min , att03_reason, att03_work_type_cd, att03_work_reward_type_cd ) VALUES ( #{overtimeReqId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{workDate}, #{overtimeMin} , #{reason}, #{workTypeCode}, #{workRewardTypeCode} )
